english.note: Use 裝保險絲 as the all-purpose verb for installing a fuse in a device or circuit.

examples.english: I installed a fuse in the computer to stop it from burning out in a short circuit.
examples.traditional: 我幫部電腦裝保險絲，費事短路燒壞。
